title: Harness (shared)
description: Per-harness payload shapes shared by ynh ls, ynh info, ynh fork, and ynh installed. Defined once here, referenced by every command schema that surfaces a harness.

Harness.description: The fields ynh ls emits per harness. ynh info extends this with a manifest field; ynh fork uses a narrower variant (see Fork).

id.description: Canonical, host-prefixed harness id. "<host>/<org>/<repo>/<name>" for remote installs, "local/<name>" for local/forked/aliased.

namespace.description: URL-derived "<org>/<repo>" for namespaced installs. Empty for flat/local. Back-compat only; new consumers should prefer id.

kind.description: Open-set classification: local-fork, local, registry, git, local-fork-broken, or "-" for pre-migration entries with no recorded source. Consumers MUST tolerate unknown values.

sha_available.description: Live upstream SHA for the harness source itself (probed via ls-remote). Distinct from ref_available, which for registry harnesses comes from the registry entry's recorded SHA.

broken_reason.description: Non-empty when the harness registration exists but the source could not be loaded. Kind is "local-fork-broken" in this case.

HarnessWithManifest.description: Harness as emitted by ynh info — same fields as Harness plus the raw plugin.json manifest. Modeled separately rather than as allOf because the artifacts field is omitted in info per current emission.

mcp_servers.description: The MCP servers a run of the harness carries, sorted by name: those of every harness its includes reach, then its own. Includes are resolved from disk and the cache only, never the network.

mcp_servers_error.description: Present when the servers of includes could not be read (an include not in the cache, or two includes declaring one server differently); mcp_servers then lists only the harness's own.

hooks.description: The hooks a run of the harness carries, sorted by event. Within an event they are in the order a run fires them: those of included harnesses whose include says "hooks": true first, then the harness's own. Includes are resolved from disk and the cache only, never the network.

hooks_not_active.description: Per event, each included harness that declares hooks a run does not carry, because its include does not say "hooks": true. Sorted by event.

hooks_error.description: Present when the hooks of includes could not be read (an include not in the cache, or a hook script outside its included harness); hooks then lists only the harness's own.

selection.description: Present when ynh info was given --profile or --focus. mcp_servers and hooks are then what a run with that selection carries.

focus.description: The --focus value as given: name for the harness's own focus, namespace:name for an included harness's.

profiles.description: The profiles applied, as --profile takes them (name for the harness's own, namespace:name for an included harness's), including the one a focus names.

manifest.description: Raw plugin.json (passed through unmodified). Schema available at docs/schema/plugin.schema.json — not validated by this envelope.

ComposedMCPServer.description: One MCP server of a run, with where it was declared.

source.description: "root" for a server the harness declares itself, or the include chain that supplied it, as ynd preview names it ("eyelock/a > eyelock/b//path").

command.description: The stdio server's command, as written.

url.description: The HTTP server's URL, as written.

ComposedHook.description: One hook of a run, with where it was declared.

source.description: "root" for a hook the harness declares itself, or the include chain that supplied it, as for mcp_servers.

command.description: The command a run executes. An included harness's "./" script is shown at the path the session runs it from.

HookOrigin.description: An included harness's hooks for one event.

source.description: The include chain of the harness that declares them.

InstalledFrom.description: Provenance of the harness — where it came from, when, and (for forks) what it was forked from.

ref.description: Branch/tag/SHA recorded at install time — the ref this harness tracks.

format.description: Present when the installed content is not a ynh harness but a package ynh derives one from at load time: "agent-plugin" for an Agent Plugins package (https://agent-plugins.org). Open set; consumers tolerate unknown values.

ForkedFrom.description: Upstream provenance for a forked harness. Populated by ynh fork; absent otherwise.

Artifacts.description: Per-kind artifact counts for the harness, summed across the harness root and any resolved includes/delegates.

Include.description: Include reference declared by the harness manifest: a git source, or a local path (git empty, local set).

git.description: Git URL of the include. Empty for a local include.

local.description: Filesystem path of a local include, as declared in the manifest. Absent for a git include.

Delegate.description: Git delegate reference declared by the harness manifest.
